Name: Bastion Lunchbox Fixes
Description: v1.0.3: exact known-working runtime-v13 Bastion locator/writer with only the three requested fixes gated as selectable configurations. Requires Bingus Shared Loader.

Options.Name: Fix Configuration
Options.Description: Choose one configuration. All 3 Fixes is recommended.

SubOptions.Name: All 3 Fixes (Recommended)
SubOptions.Description: Lunch Boxes: 0% Main transfer + AV4; Side Skirts: 0% Main transfer.

SubOptions.Name: Lunch Heavy Armor + Side Skirts 0% Main
SubOptions.Description: AV4 Lunch Boxes and 0% Main-transfer Side Skirts.

SubOptions.Name: Lunch 0% Main + Heavy Armor
SubOptions.Description: Both Lunch Box fixes; Side Skirts remain vanilla.

SubOptions.Name: Lunch 0% Main + Side Skirts 0% Main
SubOptions.Description: 0% Main transfer on Lunch Boxes and Side Skirts; Lunch Box armor remains vanilla.

SubOptions.Name: Lunch Boxes Heavy Armor Only
SubOptions.Description: Changes Lunch Boxes from AV2 to AV4 only.

SubOptions.Name: Lunch Boxes 0% Main Only
SubOptions.Description: Forces Lunch Box Main Health transfer to 0% only.

SubOptions.Name: Side Skirts 0% Main Only
SubOptions.Description: Forces Side Skirt Main Health transfer to 0% only.

SubOptions.Name: All Off / Diagnostic
SubOptions.Description: Runs the exact v13 locator/validator but makes no gameplay writes.
